Frame times are the stored images' Last-Modified times; a constant lag of 60 s would move the pointing by up to 0.25 deg. NOT YET A CALIBRATION (2026-10-10): this Alabama Mesonet camera can pan. The stars give its night-time home view; the daytime study of 2026-10-02 to 10-09 (camera_by_camera/almeso/fixed_al.json) saw the view change on 1 of 8 day-to-day steps. What is missing before it can be calibrated: a per-frame test that the camera is at the home view (the picture's pan label, or a match of the daytime scene to a reference frame).
